overlaps.locator: Results, Structural and biophysical basis of epistasis in CH65, p.7
overlaps.quote: These mutations interact epistatically for each of the three antigens, though the magnitude of epistasis is higher for SI06 (explaining ~34% of the variance in KD, relative to ~24% for MA90, and ~25% for MA90-G189E, see Figure 3—figure supplement 6).
overlaps.definition_quote: In the statistical epistasis inference, the coefficients at different orders are statistically independent and so we partition the variance explained by the model for each interaction order (Figure 3—figure supplement 6).
overlaps.definition_divergence: The author variance-partition code normalizes each cumulative order R² by the maximum-order R²; GraphFLA cumulative higher_order_epistasis outputs can be contrasted using the same ratio.

input.preprocessing: Use nonmissing MA90_mean values and all 16 binary variables; compare order 1 with the author statistical model's order 5.

overlaps.definition_divergence: The paper's variance partition is based on the sixth-order G189E statistical model in the author repository; only a fifth-order GraphFLA sensitivity result was run.

input.preprocessing: Use nonmissing G189E_mean values and all 16 binary variables; paper variance-partition code uses statistical interaction order 6.

overlaps.graphfla_call: A.higher_order_epistasis(ls, order=1) and order=6; contrast 1 - R2(order=1)/R2(order=6). The order-5 main-text model was run as a separate sensitivity.
overlaps.reason: The author source script states “order_G189E = 6” (CH65-comblib-main/Figures/Epistasis_figures/frac_order_plots.py, line 45). The full order-6 dense GraphFLA feature matrix was estimated at about 7.6 GB before solver workspace, versus about 8.2 GB available, so the exact run was deferred to avoid an out-of-memory failure. The executed order-5 sensitivity was 1 - 0.7371294775748005/0.9818808201700604 = 0.24926787199374079, but it is not substituted for the paper’s order-6 target.

overlaps.quote: While the entire library binds MA90, ~83% of variants bind MA90-G189E and ~51% of variants bind SI06 (Figure 1C).
overlaps.definition_quote: Following the KD,s inference, non-binding sequences with KD,s<6 or As - Bs <1 were pinned to the titration boundary with -logKD,s = 6.
overlaps.definition_divergence: These are thresholded antigen-binding proportions. GraphFLA has no direct binder-fraction metric; fitness_distribution does not itself apply the paper's binder cutoff.

overlaps.quote: Total log probability (in arbitrary units) of all mutational paths from the unmutated common ancestor (UCA) to CH65 (left) or paths from the UCA to CH65 that pass through I-2 (right), assuming specific antigen selection scenarios are shown.
overlaps.definition_quote: The probability of any mutational step is higher if -logKD increases and lower if -logKD decreases.
overlaps.definition_divergence: Figure 5 plots scenario-weighted log probabilities for paths with fixed endpoints UCA to CH65. GraphFLA defines global_optima_accessibility as the fraction of landscape configurations that can reach the global optimum by any monotonic fitness-improving path.

input.preprocessing: No path values were read from Figure 5; no compatible printed numeric target was available.

overlaps.graphfla_call: Not run: Figure 5 provides plotted scenario likelihoods, not a printed accessible-path fraction.
overlaps.reason: The plotted model likelihood is not the fraction of configurations with a monotonic path to the global optimum; no plot point was read.

verdict_reason: Using the author QC-processed table, GraphFLA reproduced the paper’s printed sample-size targets and model-fit values at their stated precision. It matched the printed epistatic variance shares for MA90 and SI06; the author’s G189E variance partition uses a higher-order statistical model that was not run because of memory headroom, and a lower-order result is reported only as a sensitivity. The supplied local CSVs agree on shared accepted values after sign correction but omit some accepted measurements, so the author table was used. The article gives no peak count and plots pathway likelihoods under a different definition from GraphFLA global-optimum accessibility.
